meta_description:
548K likes, 3,497 comments - official_amrit_fitness on February 12, 2025: "Turn your normal roti into high-protein roti! 💪🌾

Here’s the 5 kg Multigrain Atta Recipe with all the ingredients and their benefits:

1️⃣ Black Chana (Black Chickpeas) – 250g → Adds protein and enhances texture. 2️⃣ Bajra (Pearl Millet) – 400g → Rich in fiber, aids digestion, and provides warmth in winter. 3️⃣ Moongi Sabut Daal (Whole Green Gram) – 100g → A plant-based protein, rich in fiber, and easy to digest. 4️⃣ Makki (Maize) – 500g → Adds a slightly sweet flavor and is gluten-free. 5️⃣ Oats (Jai) – 250g → High in fiber and good for heart health. 6️⃣ Raagi (Finger Millet) – 250g → Packed with calcium and iron, great for bone health. 7️⃣ Soybean (Soya Beans) – 150g → High in protein, supports muscle building. 8️⃣ Quinoa – 150g → A complete protein with essential amino acids. 9️⃣ Flaxseeds (Alsi) – 150g → Rich in Omega-3 and fiber. 🔟 Jowar (Sorghum) – 400g → High in protein and aids digestion. 1️⃣1️⃣ Wheat (Kanak) – 2.4 kg → The base ingredient, provides structure and gluten.

Instructions:
✅ Clean and dry all grains before grinding. ✅ Roasting (optional) enhances flavor and shelf life. ✅ Grind together to form a fine multigrain flour. ✅ Store in an airtight container to maintain freshness.

This balanced multigrain mix is packed with protein, fiber, essential vitamins, minerals, and energy, while maintaining a soft and nutritious texture for rotis and parathas! 🌾🔥

🎥 Video By: @i_karamjit_singh ☑️

#atta #multigrain #recipe #healthyfood #flour #tips #selfcare #contentcreator #remedy #grain #homemade".
